description: The chart illustrates performance metrics for four methods (CoT, CCoT, CoD, and CoUT) using two different vertical scales shown in a 3D-style bar plot. The category axis is along the horizontal direction with labels CoT, CCoT, CoD, and CoUT (left to right), and each category has a single colored bar; the value axes are vertical, with one labeled “Accuracy (%)” using a linear scale with visible ticks around 75, 80, 85, 90, and 95, and a second vertical numeric scale on the right using a linear scale with tick labels at approximately 100-unit intervals (100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600) spanning roughly 0–600+. The CoT bar is red and is annotated with 91.19 (aligned with the Accuracy axis), the CCoT bar is orange and annotated with 80.89, the CoD bar is light blue and annotated with 88.50, and the CoUT bar is green and annotated with 88.40. A second set of bars aligned to the right-side numeric scale appears with the same color scheme and category order: a red bar annotated 676.85, an orange bar annotated 534.24, a light-blue bar annotated 445.91, and a green bar annotated 354.46. The bars are not shown as stacked or grouped within each category beyond the presence of these two differently scaled sets, and there is no visual indication that the categories are sorted by value; each bar has a numeric value label placed above its top, and no additional emphasis (such as outlines or shading differences) is apparent beyond the distinct colors.
